storage: Keep in the freezer at -18 °C; reseal tightly. Once thawed, use within a day and do not refreeze.
looksLike: Small, round, bright-green peas about 7 to 9 mm across; frozen ones are loose, shelled and lightly frosted.
howToPick: Loose, free-flowing, bright-green peas in an undamaged pack; avoid a pack with ice clumps (thawed and refrozen), pale or wrinkled peas.
shelfLife: Frozen peas keep for many months at -18 °C (check the pack date; general guidance, not from a source in this run).
substitutes: Cut French beans or diced carrot

usedIn.raw: 25 g per serving (2 tbsp, fresh or frozen)
